citation.authors: Taylor SC, Alexis AF, Armstrong AW, Chiesa Fuxench ZC et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.design: Review of photoprotection misconceptions in skin of colour
record.finding: The authors report that misconceptions about the benefits of photoprotection, particularly among people with Fitzpatrick V-VI skin, are still common among clinicians and patients, and that use of photoprotection in skin of colour is low.
